items.t: New Westminster has 201 hectares of industrial land in the regional inventory (July 1, 2025). ([Metro Vancouver 2025 Industrial Lands Inventory](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-planning/Documents/mv-industrial-lands-inventory-summary-report-appendices-2025.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: What sold across the Lower Mainland

Commercial Edge does not break out New Westminster in the figures published on this site. Across the Lower Mainland, 285 commercial properties sold in the second quarter of 2026, worth $1,540.8M: 81 industrial, 56 land, 46 office, 82 retail and other, and 20 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
